title: Simple Resourcepack
description: Host, Edit and Manage your resourcepacks without the need for external tools, and update your them without restarting the server.
body:
Simple Resourcepack will host all your resourcepacks directly on the server. Perfect for if you don't want to deal with external hosting. 

The plugin runs asynchronous and does not require any dependencies to run.

It allows you to distrubute updates to anyone in the server, without the need to restart the server, or users to reconnect. 

Great for itterating with a team, or in combination with other plugins that generate resourcepacks.

![The default UI of Simple Resourcepack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8971c224fff8a9cdddc2cce1c70304b941aa75b8_0.webp)

All text is fully customizable, and you can set yourself if resourcepacks are forced, or optional.

![A message you can change.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d0ab07d34915b17a92e1b1c622acb10fc455c3c0_0.webp)
